name: kata
title: Kata
description: Browse, filter, create and manage issues in the kata local-first issue tracker.
author: andy

commands.name: browse-issues
commands.title: Browse Issues
commands.subtitle: Kata
commands.description: Browse, filter and manage issues across all kata projects.

commands.name: create-issue
commands.title: Create Issue
commands.subtitle: Kata
commands.description: Create a new kata issue with priority, labels, owner and relations.

commands.name: inbox
commands.title: Inbox
commands.subtitle: Kata
commands.description: List the attention requests addressed to you across all kata projects and clear them.

commands.name: ready-issues
commands.title: Ready Issues
commands.subtitle: Kata
commands.description: List unblocked, unscheduled open issues across all projects, with the next issue to work on.

commands.name: search-issues
commands.title: Search Issues
commands.subtitle: Kata
commands.description: Full-text search over issue titles, bodies and comments in a kata project, including deleted issues.

commands.name: activity
commands.title: Activity
commands.subtitle: Kata
commands.description: Digest of recent changes, per-actor summaries, recent closes and label counts.

commands.name: kata-admin
commands.title: Kata Admin
commands.subtitle: Kata
commands.description: Read-only view of cron jobs, runs, workflows, teams, tokens and daemon health.

commands.name: manage-connections
commands.title: Manage Connections
commands.subtitle: Kata
commands.description: Add, edit, test and switch between the kata servers this extension connects to.
